amount.purpose: Money only — PaymentIntent amount, order total. The system's one display-scale role.

body.purpose: Default paragraph, table cell, and input text.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, and badge text — usually uppercase.

shadows.name: admin-ambient
shadows.purpose: Constant resting elevation on every merchant-dashboard/ops panel and card.

shadows.name: checkout-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Checkout store-item card hover only — flat at rest.

shadows.name: checkout-card-float
shadows.purpose: The payment-form card floating over a merchant's host page.

shadows.name: checkout-accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Colored glow under the storefront's gradient primary CTA.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default for color/border/background state changes (hover, focus, active) across all three surfaces.

motion.name: ease-expressive
motion.purpose: Signature overshoot-free ease-out for transform-based motion: card hover lift, entrance stagger, cart-bar interactions.

components.name: Primary Button (Admin)
components.description: pagosYa's own brand color, used only in merchant-dashboard and ops.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-admin { background: #ffbd59; color: #241804; border: 1.5px solid #ffbd59; border-radius: 9px; padding: 9px 14px; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary-admin:hover { background: #ffab2e; border-color: #ffab2e; } .ds-btn-primary-admin:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(129,140,248,0.3); }

components.name: Primary Button (Checkout Payment Form)
components.description: Deliberately neutral — embedded inside a merchant's own page, doesn't compete with their brand.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-neutral { width: 100%; background: #f5f5f5; color: #171717; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.05s ease; } .ds-btn-primary-neutral:hover { background: #fafafa; } .ds-btn-primary-neutral:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Primary Button (Checkout Storefront CTA)
components.description: pagosYa's own hosted storefront default, yields to a merchant's custom accent color when set.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-gradient { background: linear-gradient(120deg, #818cf8, #c084fc); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 13px 20px; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -6px rgba(129,140,248,0.5); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary-gradient:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -6px rgba(129,140,248,0.55); filter: brightness(1.06); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill with a leading colored dot; color set by semantic status keyword, never by position or guesswork.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-badge::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-success { background: #052e1f; color: #34d399; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #2c1a04; color: #fbbf24; } .ds-badge-error { background: #2c0b0b; color: #f87171; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field with a real <label>, never a placeholder-only field.
components.css: .ds-field label { display: block; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; color: #a3a3a3; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1.5px solid #404040; background: #171717; color: #f5f5f5; font-family: "0xProto Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #818cf8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(129,140,248,0.3); }

narrative.overview: pagosYa reads like a precise financial tool that happens to render in a developer's terminal, not a fintech marketing site that happens to show numbers. pagosYa-owned surfaces stay in 0xProto Mono. Hosted storefronts belong to the merchant and may choose one curated store-wide type family while pagosYa's own dashboard and payment assurance remain consistent. Dark is the resting state everywhere. Color is spent sparingly: a single indigo (#818cf8) carries focus rings and links, a single amber (#ffbd59) is pagosYa's own brand signal, and status colors (success/warning/error) are the only other saturation allowed in. Numbers get tabular alignment and their own oversized weight; everything else stays quiet so the numbers can be trusted. The system is explicitly context-aware about whose brand is on screen — see the Whose-Page-Is-It Rule under Colors. This is not incidental restraint; it's load-bearing, since pagosYa's checkout is frequently embedded inside a merchant's own page. The hosted storefront extends this incumbent world into a professional, merchant-first lookbook: merchant identity, authored imagery, and catalog content lead, while pagosYa recedes to the secure-payment assurance.
keyCharacteristics: Monospace-only typography on pagosYa-owned surfaces; merchant storefronts may choose one curated store-wide family
Dark-first; checkout is the only surface with a light variant, and only for contrast over a merchant's own photo background
Amber is pagosYa's brand signal, reserved for pagosYa's own tools — not used as checkout's default primary action color
Hosted storefronts behave like authored merchant lookbooks, not a generic marketplace shell; merchant imagery and merchandising lead the composition
Soft, continuous rounding (8-20px) plus true pills (999px) for chips/badges/status pills; no sharp corners except the opt-in "square" merchant theme variant
Motion is fast and utilitarian (0.15s ease) for color/border state changes; a single signature overshoot-free ease (cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)) marks the larger, more expressive transitions

rules.name: The Whose-Page-Is-It Rule
rules.body: The primary action's color is not fixed — it depends on whose page is showing. pagosYa's own tools (merchant-dashboard, ops) put pagosYa's amber on the primary button. Checkout's payment form is usually embedded inside a merchant's page, so its primary button stays neutral rather than competing with the host page. Checkout's own hosted storefront defaults to the Focus Indigo -> Focus Violet gradient as pagosYa's fallback identity, but yields to a merchant's own accentColor the moment one is set.

rules.name: The Merchant Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep panels anchored to the shared neutral system, but let the hosted storefront's page ground express the merchant's selected board material. Texture may warm or tint the canvas; it must not compete with product imagery, copy, or the merchant accent.

rules.name: The One Store, One Face Rule
rules.body: Never mix type families within a surface. pagosYa-owned UI stays on 0xProto Mono. A hosted storefront may use the merchant's single curated selection, applied consistently to the entire store.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-It-Moves Rule
rules.body: Checkout storefront surfaces stay flat at rest; a shadow only appears on hover, focus, or as the floating-card treatment for an embedded payment form. Don't add resting shadows to new checkout components.

dos: Do set every pagosYa-owned UI element in 0xProto Mono and apply a merchant's selected family consistently across their entire hosted storefront.
Do reserve Signal Amber for pagosYa's own tools (merchant-dashboard, ops); keep checkout's default primary action neutral or Focus Indigo, per the Whose-Page-Is-It Rule.
Do give every status a Badge (pill + dot + semantic color), never raw enum text or color-only signaling.
Do use real <label for> elements on every form field; placeholders are never a substitute for a label.
Do preserve the authored hero's visible pause/resume control, reduced-motion behavior, inactive-slide tab-order exclusion, and 24px minimum dot targets.
Do use the cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) ease for any new transform-based transition, and plain ease at 0.15s for color/border state changes.
donts: Don't add a resting (non-hover) shadow to a checkout storefront component — checkout is flat until it moves.
Don't invent a new accent color; the system has exactly two (Focus Indigo, Signal Amber) plus the three status colors and checkout's Focus Violet gradient partner.
Don't ship a new interactive control without a 3px Focus Indigo focus ring.
Don't treat the current single-page, no-navigation admin layout as a new-work exemplar to copy forward without checking PRODUCT.md's known-gaps note.
